rubrics.justification: It matches the provided 3AA label in broad terms, but the image itself does not clearly support a confident call of well-formed blastocoel, tightly packed ICM, cohesive AA TE, or visible zona thinning; it also adds speculative granularity/vacuolation details not reliably discernible.

It integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometriosis, prior live birth, sperm quality, and endometrial thickness into prognosis reasonably well, though some links are overstated and not all factors are equally evidence-based.

The structure is logical and the prognosis generally follows from the factors discussed, but the numeric probability adjustments are somewhat arbitrary and several modifiers (alcohol, former smoking, stress) are overstated relative to the available evidence.

Much of the response is broadly consistent with IVF practice, but recommendations such as endometrial scratch, ERA after a single failure, and immunomodulation are not strongly guideline-supported; calling alcohol cessation 'mandatory' and assuming trilaminar pattern also overreach.

It provides clear practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including luteal support, transfer technique, follow-up, and endometriosis considerations, though some suggested interventions are not strongly evidence-based.
